g.title: legend
g.text: Solid teal: input / output data or saved weights. Dashed purple: code contributes to / is used by the receiving file.
Blue: Python code. Gold: inputs / records. Green: trained outputs.
The main program orchestrates execution; helper-to-caller arrows show responsibility, not import timing.
